jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: Example Analytics is hiring a machine learning engineer to build and ship ranking models. You will own training pipelines, offline evaluation and production serving. Requirements: 3+ years of Python, experience with PyTorch, and a track record of shipping models to production.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Forecasting
jobs.snippet: Build demand forecasts for a fleet of regional warehouses. Time-series modelling, SQL and experiment design. Fully remote within the United States.
